Item Dashboard stock does not match the Stock Ledger or Stock Balance report
The
Stock Levels
on the Item dashboard can show a quantity that the
Stock Ledger
or
Stock Balance
report does not show. Or it shows "No Stock Available Currently" while the report shows stock. This page explains why the two can differ and how to make them match again.
Where to find
Stock Levels
: open the Item, then the
Inventory
tab (v16) or the
Dashboard
tab (v15).
What you see
One of these:
The Item dashboard shows stock, but the Stock Ledger is empty and the Stock Balance report shows nothing for the item.
The Stock Balance report shows a balance, but the Item dashboard shows:
No Stock Available Currently
The Item dashboard does not list all the warehouses that the Stock Balance report lists.
Repost Item Valuation
fails with:
combine() argument 2 must be datetime.time, not None
Why this happens
ERPNext keeps stock in two places:
Stock Ledger Entry
: one row for each stock movement, with its posting date and time. The
Stock Ledger
and
Stock Balance
reports read these rows. They show the balance
as on the To Date
you select in the report filters.
Bin
: one record for each item and warehouse. It holds the current quantity:
Actual Qty
,
Reserved Qty
,
Ordered Qty
,
Projected Qty
and more. ERPNext updates the Bin each time you submit or cancel a stock transaction. The Item dashboard reads only the Bin.
The Bin takes
Actual Qty
from the last stock ledger entry, by posting date and time. That entry can be in the future. So the two can differ for these reasons:
A future-dated entry.
If a stock transaction has a posting date after today, the Bin already shows the quantity after that entry. The Stock Balance report with today as
To Date
does not include it.
The dashboard hides warehouses with zero quantity.
It lists a warehouse only when at least one quantity in the Bin is not zero. A warehouse with a balance today but zero after a future-dated entry does not show.
The Bin is out of date.
The Bin was not updated after a change to the stock ledger. For example, someone deleted stock ledger entries directly in the database, a submission was interrupted, or a repost failed. ERPNext versions before v16.14.0 and v15.104.3 also had a bug: a repost did not reset the Bin to zero when no stock ledger entry was left for the item and warehouse.
Cases 1 and 2 are correct behavior. Case 3 needs a fix.
Example: a future-dated entry
Al Noor Foodstuff Trading LLC receives 60 cartons of
Mango Juice 1 L Carton (Case of 12)
into
Jebel Ali Main Store - ANF
on 15-10-2026. Then the store keeper submits a Stock Reconciliation that sets the quantity to 0, but posts it on 02-11-2026 by mistake.
On 23-10-2026:
The
Stock Balance
report, with
To Date
23-10-2026, shows a balance of 60.
The Item dashboard shows "No Stock Available Currently". The Bin already has the quantity after the 02-11-2026 reconciliation, which is 0.
How to fix it
Step 1: Compare the Bin with the Stock Ledger
Open the
Stock Ledger
report.
Set
Item
and
Warehouse
. Set
From Date
to the first stock transaction of the item, and
To Date
to a date far in the future, for example 31-12-2027.
Look at the
Balance Qty
of the last row. This is the quantity the Bin must have.
Look at the
Posting Date
of the last rows. If a date is after today, you have case 1.
Go to
Bin
(type "Bin List" in the search bar) and filter by
Item Code
and
Warehouse
.
Compare
Actual Qty
with the
Balance Qty
from step 3.
Step 2: Check the Stock Ledger Variance report
The
Stock Ledger Variance
report finds stock ledger entries whose balance does not add up. For each item and warehouse, it adds the
Qty Change
and the
Change in Stock Value
of every entry, and compares the running total with the
Qty After Transaction
and
Balance Stock Value
stored on the entry. It shows the first entry where the two differ.
Go to
Stock
workspace →
Audit Reports
→
Stock Ledger Variance
, or type "Stock Ledger Variance" in the search bar.
Set
Company
. To check one item, also set
Item
and
Warehouse
.
Optional: set
Difference In
to see one type of difference only:
Quantity (A - B)
: the balance quantity is wrong.
Value (G - D)
: the balance value is wrong.
Valuation (I - K)
: the valuation rate does not match the balance value divided by the balance quantity.
Look at the rows. Each row is one item and warehouse with a difference. A value in
A - B
,
G - D
or
I - K
that is not zero shows what is wrong. The
Posting Date
,
Voucher Type
and
Voucher No
show the first entry where it went wrong.
If the report shows no row for the item, the stock ledger is correct. A wrong quantity on the Item dashboard then comes from the Bin or a future-dated entry: go to Step 3 or Step 4.
If the report shows a row for the item, the stock ledger itself is wrong. Fix it with Step 5. Then do Step 4 to update the Bin.
To see every entry of one item and warehouse with these checks, open the
Stock Ledger Invariant Check
report.
Step 3: Fix a future-dated entry
If the last entry has a wrong future date:
Open the transaction from the
Voucher #
column of the Stock Ledger.
Cancel it and amend it.
Set the correct
Posting Date
and
Posting Time
. To change them, select
Edit Posting Date and Time
first.
Submit it.
The Item dashboard now shows the same quantity as the Stock Balance report for today.
If the date is correct, nothing is wrong. To see the same number in both places, set the
To Date
of the Stock Balance report to the date of the last entry.
Step 4: Recalculate the Bin
If the Bin
Actual Qty
is different from the last
Balance Qty
in the Stock Ledger, recalculate the Bin:
Open the Bin record for the item and warehouse.
Click
Recalculate Values
(in v15:
Recalculate Bin Qty
).
Check the message "Bin Values Recalculated" (in v15: "Bin Qty Recalculated"). Then reload the page to see the new values.
ERPNext sets
Actual Qty
from the last stock ledger entry. If there is no stock ledger entry, it sets
Actual Qty
to 0. It also recalculates the reserved, ordered, planned and projected quantities.
Reload the Item and check
Stock Levels
on the
Inventory
tab (v15:
Dashboard
tab).
Step 5: Repost the valuation if the ledger itself is wrong
If the Stock Ledger Variance report shows the item, or the
Balance Qty
or values in the Stock Ledger are wrong, run Repost Item Valuation (the job that recalculates the stock ledger and the accounting entries from a date). For example, this can happen after a backdated entry or a failed repost.
A repost changes the
Stock In Hand
and stock expense accounts in the Trial Balance and the
Balance Value
in the Stock Balance report.
From the Stock Ledger Variance report:
In the report, select the check box of each row to repost.
Click
Create Reposting Entries
.
Read the message and click
Yes
.
ERPNext makes one Repost Item Valuation for each row. It starts from the
Posting Date
and
Posting Time
of the first wrong entry. The message "Reposting entries created" lists them.
Wait until each entry has
Status
Completed
.
Run the Stock Ledger Variance report again. The item must not show now.
Do Step 4 again.
Manually:
Go to
Stock → Repost Item Valuation
and click
+ Add Repost Item Valuation
.
Set
Based On
to
Item and Warehouse
.
Set
Item Code
,
Warehouse
and
Company
.
Set
Posting Date
to the date of the first wrong entry. Also set
Posting Time
.
Click
Save
, then
Submit
.
Wait until
Status
is
Completed
. Then do Step 4 again.
If the repost fails with
combine() argument 2 must be datetime.time, not None
, the
Posting Time
is empty. Amend the entry, set
Posting Time
, and submit it again.
How to prevent it
Do not post stock transactions with a future date. If you must, tell your team, because the Item dashboard will show the quantity after that date.
Do not delete Stock Ledger Entries, Bins or stock transactions directly in the database. To undo a transaction, cancel it.
If you run your own server, keep ERPNext updated. Versions v16.14.0 and v15.104.3 fix a case where a repost left the old quantity in the Bin.
Check
Repost Item Valuation
for entries with
Status
Failed
and fix them.
Run the
Stock Ledger Variance
report once a month, for example before you close the books.
In v16.28.0 and later, you can let ERPNext do this check each week. Go to
Stock Reposting Settings
and select
Auto Repost Incorrect Valuation Entries (Weekly)
. ERPNext then scans the Stock Ledger Variance for the current fiscal year and makes the reposts for you.
If this does not fix it
Raise a support ticket if:
Recalculate Values
does not change the Bin, or the quantity comes back after a few transactions.
Repost Item Valuation fails with an error other than the one on this page.
Include:
The item code and the warehouse.
The quantity on the Item dashboard, the Bin
Actual Qty
, and the last
Balance Qty
in the Stock Ledger.
A screenshot of the Stock Ledger report with the filters visible.
A screenshot of the Stock Ledger Variance report for the item and warehouse.
The name of the failed Repost Item Valuation entry and its
Error Log
, if any.
Whether anyone changed stock data directly in the database or with a custom script.
